Monday – Friday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Practice Area
Steady counsel on custody, maintenance, guardianship and succession.
Overview
We advise on child custody and guardianship, maintenance and interim maintenance, domestic violence proceedings, adoption, and succession and inheritance disputes across the personal laws applicable in India.
Family matters carry consequences that outlast the litigation, particularly where children are involved. We push for negotiated and mediated outcomes wherever they are achievable and safe, and litigate firmly where they are not. Where there are allegations of violence or coercion, protection comes before procedure.
Services Offered
Child custody, visitation and guardianship petitions
Maintenance and interim maintenance claims and defences
Domestic violence complaints and protection orders
Adoption and legal guardianship documentation
Succession certificates, probate and inheritance disputes
Family settlement and partition agreements
Our Process
Four stages, each with a defined output — so you always know what has happened and what comes next.
A confidential session to understand the family situation, the immediate risks, and what outcome would actually work for you.
Where there is risk to a spouse or child, or a maintenance shortfall, we seek interim relief before the main proceeding advances.
We attempt a settlement or mediated parenting arrangement where it is safe and realistic, documented so it is enforceable.
Where settlement fails, we conduct the petition through evidence and arguments, keeping the child's interest at the centre of the case.
Benefits
These are commitments, not aspirations. If we fail one of them on your matter, tell the partner handling it.
Consultations handled with discretion and without judgement
Settlement pursued first, litigation conducted firmly when needed
Realistic guidance on custody and maintenance outcomes
Enforceable documentation for negotiated arrangements
Related
Get In Touch
Tell us about your matter and we will respond within one working day. Every enquiry is confidential from the moment it reaches us.
Messages answered during office hours.
